newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber extends losses at close.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber extends losses at close.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended lower, extending overnight losses due to bearish sentiment and falls in overseas market, dealers said.
"There were also no strong and keen enquiries from consumers except for some scattered interest from South Korea and light European demand for latex," a dealer said.
"Prices also fell in line with Tokyo market."
Activity was slow with business mainly from hand-to-mouth basis, they said. Trading houses offered drum latex at 236 to 237 cents a kg, SMR CV at 357 cents, SMR L at 338 and SMR 10 at 298.
But producers are not selling heavily due to an anticipation of tight supply during the wintering period, they said.
At the close, March RSS 1 buyer was marked down 1.50 cents at 300 cents ($1.21) a kg and March SMR 20 eased a cent to 294 cents.

The INRO five-day moving average was Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg was 233.56 on February 24 against 234.09 on February 21. The daily indicator price was 231.42 against 232.65 -Tan Lee Lee - (603-2307510) ($1= 2.4790)
